name: @kkutysllb/dsh-git-panel
description: dsh-external in-box dsh bundle: standalone git workspace panel as an independent right-side floating panel. v1.0.1 adds a GitHub section backed by the gh CLI: open PR/issue lists with counts, one-click create PR (auto-pushes the current branch), squash merge with inline confirm, create issue, and browser-open links; degrades gracefully when gh is absent. v1.0.2 adds a QiLin dual-channel manifest (qilin.bundle.patch alongside dsh.*) and a full client teardown for runtime disable/HMR. v1.1.0 adapts to dsh 0.2.x: the toggle button now falls back to the native conversation-header corner seat (plus anchor upgrade for late desktop titlebars), the current session comes from a three-level source (list snapshot current -> session-row data-row-key -> persisted selection) so the panel tracks the workspace again, the inset selector follows the detailsCol -> rightbarCol rename, and the manifest declares manifestVersion/engines.dsh/peerDependencies against the 0.2.x compatibility gate.
